error.message: E-KB-MAINTAINER-REQUIRED: kb_import with an explicit path ('<SCRATCH_REPO_A>/.fleet/kb-canonical.json') keeps the bible's confidence, which is equivalent to kb_promote, so it needs the kb_maintainer grant; this member session does not carry it and nothing was imported. Remediation: Call kb_import without path to import your own checkout bible (.fleet/kb-canonical.json), or run the import from the kb_maintainer session or a FULL session.
